timeOrNumber.description: The shape CycloneDX-style trend axes use: a value that is either an RFC3339 timestamp or a number. Before temporal support the format disqualified the variant and the whole field degraded to interface{}.

day.description: A `date` variant holds types.SerializableDate, as a `date` field does: time.Time would reject "2024-01-02" and accept a full date-time.

stillRejected.description: A non-temporal constraint still disqualifies the wrapper, and the fidelity warning still reports it.
